title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: ISO: 60.0% on 20 attempts; Cut: 55.0% on 20 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 43.1% overall clip on 15+ attempts. ISO: keep a gap, show help at the level of the ball and make him score over a crowd. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
supporting_stats: Spot-Up: 27.8% on 79 attempts; Hand Off: 33.3% on 15 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 43.1% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: Hand Off: 6 TO in 21 uses (28.6% vs 15.1% across all actions); P&R Ball Handler: 6 TO in 26 uses (23.1% vs 15.1% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
